metadata.question: Does Asir, Saudi Arabia show higher NDVI in June 2016 and  2017, compared with the long-term average for that period from 2003–2011?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1) which spans 2000-present at 250m, 16-day composite, ideal for long-term NDVI comparison.No cloud mask needed (pre-composited). Location: Asir province, SW Saudi (approx. geom provided). 2. Masking: Not required—MOD13Q1 is cloud-screened composite. 3. Logic: Compute mean NDVI for June (day-of-year 153–181 inclusive) for 2003-2011 baseline and for June 2016 & 2017 separately. If any of these collections is empty → C1. After masking/extraction, if pixel count == 0 → C2. If extracted means are None/NaN → C3. Answer A if both 2016 and 2017 June means are strictly greater than the 2003-2011 June mean, else B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([42, 17.5, 44, 19.5]) # Asir rough bounds june = ee.Filter.calendarRange(153, 181, 'day_of_year') # 2. Baseline 2003-2011 base = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1').filterBounds(geom).filter(june).filterDate('2003-01-01', '2011-12-31') if base.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No baseline images.") print("C1") base = base.select('NDVI') cnt_base = base.first().reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() if cnt_base == 0: print("No valid baseline pixels.") print("C2") mean_base = base.mean().reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() if mean_base is None: print("C3") # 3. Target years 2016, 2017 col16 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1').filterBounds(geom).filter(june).filterDate('2016-06-01', '2016-06-30') col17 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1').filterBounds(geom).filter(june).filterDate('2017-06-01', '2017-06-30') s16, s17 = col16.size().getInfo(), col17.size().getInfo() if s16 == 0 or s17 == 0: print("Missing 2016 or 2017 images.") print("C1") mean16 = col16.select('NDVI').mean().reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() mean17 = col17.select('NDVI').mean().reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() if mean16 is None or mean17 is None: print("C3") print(f"2003-11 mean: {mean_base/1e4:.3f}, 2016: {mean16/1e4:.3f}, 2017: {mean17/1e4:.3f}") if mean16 > mean_base and mean17 > mean_base: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([42, 17.5, 44, 19.5])  # Asir rough bounds
june = ee.Filter.calendarRange(153, 181, 'day_of_year')

# 2. Baseline 2003-2011
base = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1').filterBounds(geom).filter(june).filterDate('2003-01-01', '2011-12-31')
if base.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No baseline images.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
base = base.select('NDVI')
cnt_base = base.first().reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
if cnt_base == 0:
    print("No valid baseline pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
mean_base = base.mean().reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
if mean_base is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

# 3. Target years 2016, 2017
col16 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1').filterBounds(geom).filter(june).filterDate('2016-06-01', '2016-06-30')
col17 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1').filterBounds(geom).filter(june).filterDate('2017-06-01', '2017-06-30')
s16, s17 = col16.size().getInfo(), col17.size().getInfo()
if s16 == 0 or s17 == 0:
    print("Missing 2016 or 2017 images.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
mean16 = col16.select('NDVI').mean().reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
mean17 = col17.select('NDVI').mean().reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
if mean16 is None or mean17 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

print(f"2003-11 mean: {mean_base/1e4:.3f}, 2016: {mean16/1e4:.3f}, 2017: {mean17/1e4:.3f}")
if mean16 > mean_base and mean17 > mean_base:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
